purpose: Validate native22 checkpoints through an isolated locally built and installed wheel, after full21 completes.
runtime: CPU float32; batches8; same frozen preprocessing and shared language threshold as training.
populations: All per-language native22 development and calibration rows; no fresh probes.
accuracy_gate: Each language and formal/conversational stratum: concern recall >=99%, false review rate <=5%, abstentions count as errors.
qualification: Parity can pass while accuracy fails. Neither is itself a stable release approval.
installation: Wheel built offline with isolated packaging tools and installed with --no-deps --no-index into a fresh target. Runtime imports must resolve inside that target. Torch dependencies use the existing pinned research environment.
input_validation: Reject malformed/oversized selected prefixes before copying. Future turns remain excluded.
